conflictingProvisions.rationale: Part 110 requires enumeration of the specific conflicting provisions before any authority determination or decision. No V5.3 provisions exist to enumerate; constructing a conflict inventory from an absent text would require fabricating provisions that were never received.

authorityDetermination.rationale: Whether V5.3 supersedes, amends, parallels, or is subordinate to the V5.1/V5.2 corpus cannot be determined from a missing text. The CoreGrid governance hierarchy (security invariants, privacy, Constitution, ADRs, ...) forbids re-ranking any provision without evidence. The operator's directive is supreme human authority as an ORDER to reconcile; an order to reconcile is not itself the reconciled text.

rationale: Part 110 reconciliation is an evidence-governed process. Reconciling against absent text would fabricate provisions, violating the canonical-truth principle (Constitution section 9: intelligence must never overwrite reality) and the Final Commandment (do not guess; inspect, reason, validate, test, audit). Recording the absence — its verification, the blocked state, and the governing corpus — is the only truthful Part 110 record possible.
